english.title: Obtain an article for supply for use to commit / to assist in commission of s1 / 3 / 3ZA computer misuse offence
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) obtained an article, namely **(..SPECIFY THE ARTICLE..),

(A)_[intending to use it to commit, or to assist in the commission of, an offence under section 1, 3 or 3ZA]_
(B)_[with a view to its being supplied for use to commit, or to assist in the commission of, an offence under section 1 or 3]_

of the Computer Misuse Act 1990, namely **(..SPECIFY THE OFFENCE..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 3A(3) and (5) of the Computer Misuse Act 1990.

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: Due to the legislative amendments made by section 42 of the Serious Crime Act 2015 the start date for this offence is 3rd May 2015. For offences of this nature committed before this date see Offence Document H8774 (CM90009).

other.penalty:
Either way
Summary: 6/12 months imprisonment and / or a fine.
Indictment: 2 years imprisonment and / or a fine.

The maximum penalty on summary conviction is 6 months for offences committed before 2nd May 2002; for offences committed on or after that date it may be 6 or 12 months depending on the general limit in a magistrates’ court, see section 3A(5)(a) of the Computer Misuse Act 1990 and section 224(1) and (1A) of the Sentencing Act 2020.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None
